info.syllabusName: Thí nghiệm tin sinh học trong Khoa học y sinh (Bioinformatics Laboratory in Biomedical Sciences)
info.description:
This course is designed to provide students the basic knowledge and concepts of bioinformatics and biosoftware.

Topics include:

Databases, DNA, genetic, genomic, and Bioinformatics
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: -	Knowledge: The course introduces the basic concepts of bioinformatics, databases and gene/protein information in biological analysis
-	Skills: The course provides the basic skills in biosoftware and data analysis
-	Thinking: Know how to use and analyze the database and biosoftware
-	Attitude and behavior: Hard working, helpful attitude and ready to join teamwork activities
